written.headline: AI labs may hold unreleased breakthroughs that could break current cryptosystems

written.headline: Memory chip shortages spark global procurement war rooms and 10x price hikes
written.summary: Companies worldwide have created procurement war rooms as a global memory chip shortage pushes some chip prices up tenfold in a year, driving higher electronics prices.

written.headline: OpenAI fixes billing error, usage limits hit 40% faster on Astra, 25% faster on Sol
written.summary: OpenAI corrected a launch‑day billing mistake that had under‑discounted GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol usage, causing users to reach their plan limits 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol, and added a one‑time banked reset for all plans.

written.headline: NVIDIA B300 AI chip orders face up to 40‑week wait; RTX 60 GPU may slip past 2027
written.summary: New orders for NVIDIA’s B300 AI chips now have lead times of 26 to 40 weeks, while GB300 orders wait 14 to 26 weeks, according to Taiwanese ODMs. Production of the consumer‑focused RTX 60 series, originally slated for late 2027, could be delayed further as memory shortages and a shift toward data‑center chips tighten supply.

written.headline: BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
written.summary: BharatGen has launched Patram 1.5, a 7.8-billion-parameter open-weight vision-language model designed to process complex, multilingual, and poor-quality documents as images. The model features prompt-controlled OCR and abstention capabilities, and is available on Hugging Face and the BharatGen Playground.
